text_block_list.text:
I spotted Special Week and Seiun Sky
walking together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer-san, are you here for karaoke too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm about to do some intense training at karaoke~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Since there's no training today,
we decided to practice for the Winning Live instead!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We were supposed to go eat hamburgers together,
but then out of nowhere, she said eating out was off-limits...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Could Spe-chan's weight recently be...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aah, aah! Enough of that kind of talk!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Come on, for the sake of everyone cheering me on, I've got to practice my singing properly!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, let's just go with that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right.
Trainer, would you like to join me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Taking care of things for the Winning Live
is an important part of a Trainer's job too, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great!
Trainer-san, please give us some advice too!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go together then, okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thank you so much~!
Now I'm even more fired up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, as expected of you, Trainer.
You've gotta take proper care of your trainee!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Sunny day, bright and gay, racing all the way♪"...
"Sunny day, bright and bray"... Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You can slow down the tempo in karaoke, so why not practice at a slower pace first?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I see! I'll try that!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess I'll go ahead
and order some food~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You're going to order food!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We were supposed to eat, but it suddenly turned into karaoke, right?
That's why I'm starving.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What should I get... Pizza, fried chicken,
cheeseburger, carrot sticks...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Spe-chan,
maybe you shouldn't push yourself so hard?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Weight is important, but eating delicious food
and getting proper nutrition is important too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: B-But... my weight...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone who supports me,
I want to return their feelings during the live concert, too...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yes, making my grand entrance right here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan is trying so hard for her fans
that she's even cutting back on her meals.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"On the other hand, though, I also want to eat
delicious hamburgers and carrots."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What is the best choice for Spe-chan right now?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Let's recharge our energy for everyone's sake!
Let's endure and push through for everyone's sake!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: For everyone's sake... Understood!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat well, get plenty of nutrition,
and do my absolute best for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, lend me your menu, Sei-chan!
I need to fuel up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees, don't be shy about asking!
That's why you have adults around, after all!
choice_data_list: You invited me just for that!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nfufu~♪ Who kno~ws?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Either way, thanks to you, Trainer,
it all worked out as a plus for Spe-chan!
Afterward, the three of us enjoyed delicious food and karaoke together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...You're right! It's because I give it my all that everyone cheers for me!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right! Endure, endure!
I'll power through with sheer willpower, ohhh-!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I see~...
Well then, maybe I'll pass on eating it too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, I'm going to be Spartan with our live performance practice.
Because now I understand your resolve, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? No waaaay!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, pick the tempo back up!
Singing slowly like that is far too soft!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees~!!

Afterward, the three of us enjoyed karaoke,
focusing mainly on live performance practice.
